title: Privacy Policy
intro: At BucksPay ("BucksPay", "we", "our") we respect your privacy. This Privacy Policy describes what data we collect when you use our mobile application (BucksPay, package com.buckspay.mobile) and our website buckspay.xyz (collectively, the "Services"), how we use it, with whom we share it, and what rights you have over it.
By using the Services you accept the practices described in this Policy. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.

whoWeAre.title: 1. Who we are
whoWeAre.bodyBefore: BucksPay operates a digital wallet that lets you send, receive and manage money simply. The data controller for your personal data is the BucksPay team, reachable at

dataCollected.title: 2. Data we collect
dataCollected.intro: We only collect the data necessary to operate the Services. Specifically:

account.title: 2.1. Registration and account data
items: First and last name
Email address
Phone number
Country and identification document type / number
Username (handle in the form @user)
Password (stored as a hash, never in plain text)

financial.title: 2.2. Financial and transaction data
items: Wallet addresses (public) associated with your account and the blockchain
Balance, transaction history, amounts sent and received
Crypto buy / sell operations (on-ramp / off-ramp)

The private keys that custody your funds are stored encrypted in the device's secure storage (iOS Keychain / Android Keystore). They never leave the device in plain text and we do not store them on our servers in a form that would let us access your funds.

permissions.title: 2.3. Device permissions
permissions.intro: The app requests the following permissions. In all cases you can deny or revoke them from the operating system settings; the app will keep working though some features will become unavailable.
items: Camera: to send photos in the in-app chat and, where applicable, scan payment QR codes.
Gallery / Storage: to attach existing images in the chat.

Contacts: we use your address book locally to detect which of your contacts already have BucksPay and make it easy to send them money. We only upload to our servers the phone numbers or emails strictly needed to do the cross-check, hashed where technically feasible. We do not sell this information nor use it for any purpose other than that feature.

Biometrics (Face ID / fingerprint): optional, to protect access to the app and authorize transactions. Biometric verification happens entirely on the device; we never receive or store your fingerprint, face or biometric template.
Push notifications: to alert you about transactions, messages and relevant events.

device.title: 2.4. Device and usage data
items: Device model, operating system and app version
Technical identifiers (push notification token, install identifier)
Configured language and region
IP address (for fraud detection and abuse prevention)
Technical logs: errors, performance metrics and aggregated usage events

communications.title: 2.5. Communications data
items: Chat messages sent through the app (including attached images)
Any information you voluntarily send us when contacting support

purposes.title: 3. What we use your data for
items: Create and operate your account and wallet
Process and record your transactions, show you your history and balances
Allow you to send and receive payments, messages and notifications to other users
Verify your identity when applicable regulation requires it (KYC/AML)
Detect and prevent fraud, money laundering, service abuse and unlawful activity
Provide support when you contact us
Improve the app: fix bugs, optimize performance and understand which features are used most
Comply with applicable legal, tax and regulatory obligations

legalBases.title: 4. Legal bases for processing
legalBases.intro: We process your data on the basis of:
items: Performance of the contract you accept by using the Services.
Consent, especially for device permissions (contacts, camera, biometrics) and marketing communications where applicable. You can withdraw it at any time.
Compliance with legal obligations in financial matters, fraud prevention and AML/KYC.
Legitimate interest in keeping the platform secure and improving the service, balanced against your rights.

sharing.title: 5. Who we share your data with
sharing.intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with:
sharing.providersTitle: Infrastructure providers that help us operate the service, under data processing agreements:
providers: Google Firebase (authentication, real-time database, storage, analytics, messaging). Data processed on Google's infrastructure.
Pusher (real-time messaging for chat and in-app notifications).
Google Cloud / Firebase Cloud Messaging and Apple Push Notification Service for push notifications.

On-ramp / off-ramp providers for the purchase and sale of crypto assets. When you use these features, the strictly necessary data (identity, amount, recipient) is shared with the selected provider, which acts as an independent controller under its own privacy policy.
others: Public blockchain networks: on-chain transactions are by design public and immutable. Anyone can look up addresses, amounts and counterparties on the relevant network's explorer. We do not publish your name, email or phone on-chain, but your wallet address is permanently recorded.
Authorities when there is a court order, valid legal request or regulatory obligation that requires us to share information.
Potential acquirers in the event of a merger, acquisition or corporate restructuring, subject to confidentiality obligations and to this Policy.

transfers.title: 6. International transfers
transfers.body: Some of our providers (Firebase, Pusher, etc.) operate from the United States and other jurisdictions. By using the Services you accept that your data may be transferred outside your country of residence. We take reasonable measures (standard contractual clauses, certified providers) so that those transfers maintain an adequate level of protection.

retention.title: 7. Data retention
retention.body1: We keep your data while your account is active and for the additional time needed to comply with legal obligations (for example, accounting and AML records that may require between 5 and 10 years depending on the jurisdiction), resolve disputes or enforce our agreements. When no longer needed, we delete or anonymize them.
retention.body2: Transactions recorded on-chain on public blockchains cannot be deleted due to their immutable nature.

security.title: 8. Security
items: Your private keys are stored in the device's secure enclave (Keychain on iOS, Keystore on Android).
Communications with our servers travel encrypted with HTTPS/TLS.
Passwords are stored hashed with one-way algorithms.
We apply access controls, monitoring and periodic security reviews.
security.footer: No system is 100% secure. We recommend enabling biometric authentication, not sharing your credentials, and keeping your device and the app up to date.

rights.title: 9. Your rights
rights.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction (GDPR in the EU, CCPA in California, LGPD in Brazil, local laws in LatAm), you may have the right to:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you
Rectify inaccurate or incomplete data
Delete your account and associated data (subject to legal retention obligations)
Object to or limit certain processing
Port your data to another provider
Withdraw previously granted consents
File a complaint with the data protection authority
rights.footerBefore: To exercise any of these rights, write to us at
rights.footerAfter: . We will respond within a reasonable time and in accordance with applicable law.

minors.title: 10. Minors
minors.body: BucksPay is not directed to persons under 18 years of age. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If you believe a minor has provided us with data, contact us to delete it.

cookies.title: 11. Cookies and similar technologies (website)
cookies.body: Our website may use cookies strictly necessary for its operation, plus browser local storage to remember preferences (language, theme). We do not use third-party advertising cookies. The mobile application does not use cookies, but does use local and secure device storage as described above.

changes.title: 12. Changes to this Policy
changes.body: We may update this Policy to reflect changes in the Services or regulation. If changes are material we will give you reasonable advance notice in the app, by email, or via a visible notice on buckspay.xyz. The "Last updated" date above always indicates the current version.

contact.title: 13. Contact
contact.intro: If you have questions about this Policy or your data:
